title: UMBRELLA - Engine diet: drop or port custom-node packs into MpiNodes
description: Cut the engine's third-party custom-node packs down to the few nodes we use, ported into MpiNodes, so the engine installs fewer pip packages and breaks less. Keep LTXVideo, ChatterBox, MelodramaBox, GGUF. Children MPI-1337..MPI-1343; phases and ownership in plan.md.
